description: A user adds a new entry to the email blocklist (an address or a whole domain). Describe exactly how the server reacts: which component notices the new blocklist record, how the work is handed off, which stored message data is removed and how orphaned messages/threads are cleaned up afterwards. Include how domain entries are matched and what is protected from deletion.
anchor_note: non-bug task: root_cause_symbols holds the anchor (entry point / changed symbol); RC metrics are reported for category A only
alternatives: Update of a blocklist entry enqueues both the delete job and the reimport job (listener lines near handleUpdatedEvent).
Calendar has an analogous listener under modules/calendar/blocklist-manager/listeners/calendar-blocklist.listener.ts.

source.verification: Run blocklist-cleanup.integration-spec.ts; or read the cited lines.
source.notes: Confounders: the job deletes channel-message ASSOCIATIONS, not message rows; orphan removal is a separate step. Both messaging and calendar have same-named patterns. The messaging cleaner method line was matched by regex 'public async cleanOrphanMessagesAndThreads' - if the declaration is 'async cleanOrphanMessagesAndThreads' the build would have failed.
